reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at the hair salon and with Nikki! She was attentive, skilled, and executed exactly what I wanted. Nikki's passion for her craft and friendly nature made the visit truly enjoyable. My hair looks fantastic, and I highly recommend her services. A five-star experience all the way!
Just got my first haircut by Nikki and it was perfect! I'm 69 and only three times in my life I had a good haircut and this was one of the best! Thank you!

I’ve been getting my haircuts from Kennadi since 2024, and I couldn’t imagine going to anyone else! She always gives me the best haircut, even when I have no idea what I want. My hair feels healthier than ever. Kennadi is so relatable and easy to talk to about anything, which makes appointments so enjoyable. Having a hairstylist you feel comfortable with makes the whole experience even better!
